query:
INSERT INTO imap_state_entries (link_id, kind, key, folder_id, received_at, document)
        SELECT
            $1,
            'message',
            'm:' || lpad(n::text, 6, '0'),
            'inbox',
            now(),
            jsonb_set($2, '{id}', to_jsonb ('m:' || lpad(n::text, 6, '0')))
        FROM
            generate_series(1, 100000) n
